rationale: r2gaussian-claude-agentic: val_n=214, gs_n_gaussians=512, gs_n_iter=150, gs_lr_pos=0.005, gs_lr_scale=0.01, gs_lr_amp=0.01, gs_lr_rot=0.01, gs_amp_init=0.01, gs_scale_init=0.04, gs_tv_weight=0.0001, gs_n_clip=0.05, gs_render=raster, gs_init_from_fbp=True, gs_amp_init_max=0.05, gs_ssim_weight=0.15, gs_outer_wall_s=1080, rationale=iter-7 (search-20260619-01) — AUTHORIZED audit-fix (b) validation, in-budget continuation. ONE KNOB: gs_ssim_weight 0.1->0.15 (from iter-6 BEST base: gs_init_from_fbp=True, gs_render=raster, n_iter=150, 512 Gaussians, gs_amp_init_max=0.05 — the config that set the run-best SSIM 0.7519). LIMITER: r2gaussian is REGIME-BOUNDED on dense 2304-view Mayo — LD-FBP (~0.808) is near-complete, the inverse is not ill-posed enough for a Gaussian-splat prior to add value, so hr>0 is implausible regardless. Secondary (now FIXED) limiter was cold uniform random-init + pure-L2 loss; iters 1-5 (cold init, L2-only) all landed BELOW the 0.808 FBP init (SSIM 0.68-0.74, hr=0). iter-6 enabled the audit-fix (b) — FBP warm-start (gs_init_from_fbp=True: positions sampled prop to fbp^2, amp seeded from FBP intensity) + SSIM loss term (gs_ssim_weight=0.1; the benchmark is SSIM-scored but the loss was pure L2) — and lifted SSIM 0.7383->0.7519 (NEW run-best, +0.0136), hr still 0. The real payoff of this fix is on the 128-view SPARSE benchmarks, NOT dense Mayo; this iter validates the authorized fix runs without regressing and measures whether MORE SSIM weight lifts SSIM further toward the LD-FBP floor. HYPOTHESIS (falsifiable in NUMBERS): a slightly stronger SSIM pull (0.1->0.15) toward FBP structure nudges the ~26 completed scenes further AT/ABOVE their FBP init, so the 214-avg SSIM rises modestly above iter-6 0.7519 toward the 0.808 LD-FBP floor. PREDICTION: SSIM in (0.75, 0.78), hr 0 (regime-bounded). NUMERIC FALSIFIER: if SSIM <= 0.7519 (no lift over iter-6 best), the FBP-init+SSIM-loss fix is exhausted as an SSIM lever on dense Mayo — fix VALIDATED AS FAITHFUL-BUT-REGIME-BOUNDED (its payoff is the sparse benchmarks). BUDGET: gs_init_from_fbp adds ~0 per-step cost (init only); the SSIM term is one cheap conv-SSIM per step vs the dominating 2304-view projection, so per-step stays ~0.282 s and coverage ~26/214 (same as iter-6, elapsed_s 1131 < 1800 SLURM wall). gs_outer_wall_s=1080 self-truncates before the 30-min kill, val figure excluded. val_n=214 per mandate; staged_canonical / v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geom / per-sample-ps (single-val-ps probe) / bg_target=truth / 321px-FOV-default / gs_render=raster all hard-wired. gs_render stays raster (the splat path is the DEFERRED (a) fix and raises NotImplementedError). TRAJECTORY: iter-1 0.7383 (cold/L2) -> iter-6 0.7519 (warm FBP-init + SSIM@0.1, BEST) -> iter-7 = SSIM weight 0.1->0.15, the does-MORE-SSIM-help test of the authorized audit-fix (b).
